query:
SELECT
                    g.id AS "id: GuestbookId",
                    g.message,
                    g.signature,
                    g.created_at,
                    g.updated_at,
                    g.author_id AS "author_id: GuestId",
                    u.username AS author_username
                FROM guestbook g JOIN guests u ON u.id = g.author_id
                WHERE (g.created_at, g.id) < ($1, $2)
                ORDER BY g.created_at DESC, g.id DESC
                LIMIT $3
